topics.topic: Canonical modeling/persistence of file output ports in TrialExecution outputs (and StoredValue carriage)
questions: If a function contract has a file output port, how must a TrialExecution record that produced file output be modeled and persisted?

topics.topic: How purpose is sourced and whether it is mandatory when first creating a Slot/Flow via initial version actions
questions: When the first contract version creates a new slot, how is `purpose` provided (required in that same request, optional, or kernel-filled)?
When the first composed version creates a new flow, where does `purpose` come from and is it mandatory?

topics.topic: Rules for authored TrialCase data: who assigns disclosure_class and how expected_outputs are validated (including full vs partial output coverage)
questions: When an agent adds an authored TrialCase, who sets disclosure_class for TrialCase.inputs and authored expected_outputs, and what validation rule applies?
If expected_outputs is present, must it include every output port of the contract version, or can it assert only a subset of outputs?

topics.topic: Whether NodeExecution.executed is set or omitted when status is refused_by_owner
questions: For status `refused_by_owner` (effect not sent because owner refused), is `executed` present (binding referenced) or absent (node treated as not executed)?

topics.topic: Whether proven read-only flow versions auto-activate at proof time or require an explicit activate action
questions: Is a proven read-only flow version activated automatically at proof time, or only when the activate action is called?
